containerOverrides.name: backend
command:
import os, json, psycopg

dsn = os.environ.get('APP_DB_URL', '').strip()
assert dsn, 'APP_DB_URL missing'
conn = psycopg.connect(dsn)
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute("SELECT conname, pg_get_constraintdef(oid) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'actimize_screening_type_mappings'::regclass AND contype='p'")
pk = cur.fetchall()
cur.execute("SELECT \"Search_Definition_ID\", \"Screening_Type\", search_definition_name, is_active, display_order FROM actimize_screening_type_mappings ORDER BY display_order ASC")
rows = [
  {
    'Search_Definition_ID': r[0],
    'Screening_Type': r[1],
    'Search Definition name': r[2],
    'Active': r[3],
    'Display_order': r[4],
  }
  for r in cur.fetchall()
]
print('MAPPING_SNAPSHOT', json.dumps({'pk': pk, 'row_count': len(rows), 'rows': rows}, ensure_ascii=False))
cur.close(); conn.close()
